newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian plane crashes in Caucasus, 50 feared dead.
newsitem.headline: Russian plane crashes in Caucasus, 50 feared dead.

text.p: A Russian AN-24 passenger plane crashed on Tuesday in the North Caucasus region and all 50 people on board were feared killed, a spokesman for the Emergencies Ministry said.
"We are not absolutely sure, but according to preliminary information, all of them have been killed," said the Moscow-based spokesman by telephone.
The spokesman said the plane had been heading from the Russian city of Stavropol to Trabzon in Turkey.
It crashed in a forest near the town of Cherkessk, capital of the ethnic region of Karachayevo-Cherkessiya, at 10.50 a.m. (0750 GMT), the spokesman said.
He gave no reason for the crash.
